recently visited Krispy Kreme, and overall, it was a delightful experience. The donuts were fresh, fluffy, and perfectly glazed – exactly what you'd expect from the brand. I particularly loved the classic glazed donut, which had that signature melt-in-your-mouth texture. I used the OG card which really helped me to save up while buying more at the same time. The only reason I’m giving 4 stars instead of 5 is that the service was a bit slow during my visit. Even though the shop wasn’t very crowded, I still experienced lining up for a while. Anyways, I’ll definitely be back for more donuts!

The first Krispy Kreme in Davao City. You'll be able to view the creation of the original Glazed doughnuts at the store. There are ample charging spots. The staff is quite helpful to the customer's need. The ambience is well lit suited for transient customers. The space contains 10 tables suited for a medium crowd.

They offer dine-in via the 3-4 tables at their small kiosk inside the mall. Stools are available though for quick bites. Good to note that they still have electrical outlets to charge your phones. The donuts are still the same delicious uber sweet Krispy Kremes I have known since time immemorial. Other Covid safety o Protocols are in place.

This is the absolute best of Davao City. Best doughnuts ever! Honestly, they taste better HERE than in the USA if you can believe it. Amazing people work here. I come here at least once a week for the coffee and doughnuts.
